mapper.select: SELECT t.transfer_id, t.transfer_type, t.transferred_at, m.employee_no, m.name, m.department FROM transfer t LEFT JOIN manager m ON m.employee_no = t.manager_employee_no WHERE t.transfer_id = #{transferId}

SELECT t.transfer_id, t.transfer_type, t.transferred_at, m.employee_no, m.name, m.department FROM transfer t LEFT JOIN manager m ON m.employee_no = t.manager_employee_no WHERE t.collection_id = #{collectionId} ORDER BY t.transferred_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfer (transfer_id, collection_id, manager_employee_no, transfer_type, transferred_at) VALUES (#{transferId}, #{collectionId}, #{employeeNo}, #{tr.transferType}, #{tr.transferredAt})
